caption:
Three tax changes since 1 July 2026 that most people haven't noticed yet.

1. The 16% rate on income from $18,201 to $45,000 is now 15% (2026–27), worth up to $268 a year.
2. A $1,000 standard deduction for work expenses, no receipts needed, applies automatically for wage earners from 2026–27.
3. Laundry is a flat $1 a load for work clothes (50c for mixed loads), and the old $300 no-receipts rule is gone.

Save this.
